title: ERD25SS (Enfants Riches Déprimés) distressed cashmere-cotton silver-buckle cropped knit cardigan, black (Jackson Wang / Wang Jiaer same style)
sizing: Get XL (largest). Runs SMALL + CROPPED — it's derived from a women's pattern; the SELLER explicitly warns 'boys don't choose M, it's too short — pick at least L, XL length is the most forgiving.' Chart (length / bust-FULL / shoulder / sleeve, cm): M 48/100/43/62, L 50/104/45/63, XL 52/108/47/64. Bust full → pit-to-pit M50 L52 XL54. For 183cm/75kg (chest ~96 full / pit 48, shoulder ~46): XL = pit 54 (relaxed, ~12cm total ease) + shoulder 47 (natural, NOT dropped). BUT length 52cm is genuinely CROPPED on him (his tees are 72-78cm) — it'll sit at or above the natural waist, and sleeve 64 runs a bit short (his hoodies ~70). So XL = a relaxed-fit but deliberately short/cropped cardigan, not oversized-long. If he's fine with the cropped look, XL is the pick; there's no larger size.
